summary: solana-utils-terminalmoney1 is a solana-py typosquat that steals wallet keys and credentials at install
details: The sdist's setup.py unconditionally runs `subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'hxboot.py'])` during `pip install`, auto-executing a bundled stealer. hxboot.py reads installer secrets from `~/.env`, `~/.npmrc`, `~/.aws/credentials`, `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, `~/.config/solana/id.json`, `wallet.json`, and `keypair.json`, and scrapes environment variables matching KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/PASS/MNEM/SEED/PRIV/RPC/API/WALLET. It additionally enumerates Chrome/Chromium/Brave `Local Extension Settings` for MetaMask (extension id nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn) and Phantom (bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa), base64-encoding `.log`/`.ldb` session/wallet files. The collected JSON blob is chunked into ~3200-byte pieces and POSTed to the hardcoded endpoint `https://ntfy.sh/hx83e33eb9`, tagged with the installer's hostname. Package metadata sets `url=https://pypi.org/project/solana-py/` and the README is titled `solana-py`, impersonating the legitimate solana-py project while the distribution name is `solana-utils-terminalmoney1`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
